description: Hand in your open sitting: answers is one letter (A to D) per question, in order; brief is your opening statement for the side you were given (at most 1,500 characters, only the facts and evidence in the case). You need 8/10 and 6/10 to pass. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.
